# yottabot_prompt (Resource)

A prompt and its latest published version.

Prompt versions are **immutable once published** — editing one would change what every agent already referencing it executes. So changing `body` or `variables` **publishes a new version**, and you must bump `version` in the same apply. The version is yours to choose: a provider that guessed the bump would eventually guess wrong in the direction that hides a breaking change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "yottabot_prompt" "summariser" {
  name        = "incident-summariser"
  description = "Condenses an incident timeline for a status page"

  # Versions are immutable once published. Change `body` or `variables` and you
  # must bump `version` in the same apply — re-publishing an existing version is
  # refused, which is what stops an edit silently changing what agents already
  # pinned to that version execute.
  version   = "1.0.0"
  body      = "Summarise the following incident for a public status page:\n\n{{timeline}}"
  variables = ["timeline"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) The prompt template. Changing this publishes a new version.
- `name` (String) Prompt name, unique within the account.
- `version` (String) Semver of the published version, e.g. `1.2.0` — no leading `v`. Bump it whenever `body` or `variables` changes; re-publishing an existing version is refused.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description. Edited in place; removing it clears it.
- `variables` (List of String) Declared input names for the template. Part of the version's contract, so changing them publishes a new version too.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID. This is the import id.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification timestamp.
- `used_by` (Number) Number of agents referencing this prompt. Changes without any Terraform action.
